```
override fun visitElement(context: XmlContext, element: Element) {
    val children = element.childNodes
    for (i in 0 until children.length) {
        val child = children.item(i) as? Element ?: continue
        if (child.isHelper) continue
        val hasHorizontal = HORIZONTAL_CONSTRAINTS.any { child.hasAttributeNS(AUTO_URI, it) }
        val hasVertical = VERTICAL_CONSTRAINTS.any { child.hasAttributeNS(AUTO_URI, it) }
        if (!hasHorizontal) {
            context.report(ISSUE, child, context.getLocation(child), "This view is not constrained horizontally: add constraints from the left/right or start/end edges")
        }
        if (!hasVertical) {
            context.report(ISSUE, child, context.getLocation(child), "This view is not constrained vertically: add constraints from the top/bottom or baseline")
        }
    }
}
```
